purpose: Second, independent transcription of Pulippani's vedha tables (Gochar Phaladeepika ch.22) and of where the Saturn result texts sit, read from rendered page images on 2026-10-03. test-saturn-vedha.js asserts src/report/gocharaVedhaTables.js and src/report/saturnHouseResults.js agree with it.

gochara.format: planet | benefic places as printed | Gochara Vedha places as printed | exceptions

vipareeta.format: planet | places of malefic results as printed | Vipareetha Vedha places as printed, column by column
exceptions: no Vipareetha Vedha to Sun by Saturn
vipareeta.example: Saturn 12th from Janma Rasi and Jupiter in the 3rd: Saturn's evil not felt for the year Jupiter is there (printed p.206)

verse343.reads: planets standing the other way round: even cruel planets give good (vipareeta); Sun and Mars give results at the start of a sign, Jupiter and Venus in the middle, Saturn and Moon at the end, Mercury and the nodes throughout

saturnResults.scanGap: printed pp.148-167 are not in the scan (PDF 160 is printed 147, PDF 161 is printed 168)

sundarananda.printSlip: both paragraphs say 'waxing' in every house except the 6th; the 3rd house heading is numbered '1' and the 10th house heading says 'Jupiter'

paryaya.thirdRoundGeneral: houses 10, 11, 12 in the 3rd round: "what is told in general readings for Saturn earlier will take place" (p.234)

names.4: Ardhashtama Sani or Kantaka Sani; Laghu Kalyani (Sundarananda part)
names.8: Ashtama Kantaka Sani; next to 7 1/2 years Saturn the most malefic place

saturnResults.ninth: printed p.170: "according to ancient Tamil texts ... (Raja Yoga)" vs "as per traditional Sanskrit texts, Saturn in 9th also gives bad results" — "both jointly give moderate result"
